events.verdict: Dennis (IND) attempts to go for the steal and initiates body contact with Tomlin (CLE), affecting Tomlin's SQBR.
After Porter Jr. (CLE) mishandles the ball, he re-gathers it with both hands and then proceeds to dribble again.
Thompson (CLE) makes contact with Jackson's (IND) arm, causing him to lose control of the ball during his play at the basket.
Dennis (IND) brings his right arm toward Porter Jr.'s (CLE) path, and marginal contact occurs during Porter Jr.'s drive.
Dennis (IND) reaches in and makes illegal contact with Thompson's (CLE) arm.
Porter Jr. (CLE) blocks Furphy's (IND) driving shot attempt and any ensuing contact is incidental.

events.category: Turnover: Out of Bounds – Bad Pass Turn
events.verdict: Tomlin (CLE) releases the pass and it goes out of bounds.
Bradley (IND) makes clean contact with the ball and dislodges it away from Porter Jr. (CLE) as the steal occurs.
Porter Jr. (CLE) brings his right hand forward and cleanly dislodges the ball away from Jackson (IND) during his driving shot attempt.
Bradley (IND) jumps vertically while positioned sideways, absorbing the contact during Porter Jr.'s (CLE) driving shot attempt.
Tyson (CLE) brings his right hand forward and cleanly blocks Furphy (IND) layup attempt.
Furphy (IND) grabs and pulls Thompson's (CLE) jersey away from his body, which affects his ability to pursue the rebound.

Replay review of the foul called on Porter Jr. (CLE) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed successful. Although Porter Jr. avoids making illegal contact with Jackson (IND), Tyson (CLE) jumps from point A to point B into his body and affects the shot attempt.

After communicating with the Replay Center, the ruling on the floor of a defensive goaltending violation by Tyson (CLE) is overturned. Tyson blocks the shot attempt before it reaches its apex and before it ever has a chance to make contact with the backboard.
Jackson (IND) makes clean contact with the ball and dislodges it away from Porter Jr. (CLE).
Porter Jr. (CLE) maintains a legal guarding position as he moves parallel to Jackson's (IND) path to the basket. The marginal contact is created by Jackson extending his leg.
Bradley (IND) firms up to his right leg in Tyson's (CLE) path and absorbs the contact.
Porter Jr. (CLE) briefly places a hand on Jackson's (IND) body as he jumps to contest the shot attempt near the rim. Any further marginal contact is created by Jackson.
Thompson (CLE) establishes himself in a legal guarding position in front of Bradley (IND) and absorbs the contact.
